en: Happy are the perfect of way, who walk in the Torah of Havayah.
Happy are they who keep His testimonies; with all their heart they seek Him.
They do not work iniquity; in His ways they walk.
You have commanded Your precepts, to be kept very diligently.
Would that my ways were established, to keep Your statutes.
Then I would not be ashamed, when I look to all Your commandments.

he: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לׇמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
en: I shall thank You in uprightness of heart, when I learn Your righteous judgments.
Your statutes I shall keep; do not utterly forsake me. (End of the passage.)
How shall a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
With all my heart I have sought You; let me not stray from Your commandments.

he: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶחֱטָא־לָֽךְ׃
en: In my heart I have hidden Your saying, so that I may not sin against You.
Blessed are You, Havayah; teach me Your statutes.
With my lips I have recounted all the judgments of Your mouth.
In the way of Your testimonies I rejoice, as over all riches.
In Your precepts I shall meditate, and I shall look at Your ways.
In Your statutes I shall delight; I shall not forget Your word. (End of the passage.)
Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
Uncover my eyes, that I may see wonders from Your Torah.

he: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
en: I am a sojourner in the earth; hide not Your commandments from me.
My soul breaks with longing for Your judgments at all times.
You have rebuked the accursed insolent, who stray from Your commandments.

he: גַּ֣ל מֵ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃
en: Roll off me reproach and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.

he: גַּ֤ם יָשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
en: Though princes sit and speak against me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
Indeed Your testimonies are my delights, the men of my counsel. (End of the passage.)
My soul clings to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
Make me understand the way of Your precepts, and I shall meditate on Your wonders.
My soul drips from grief; uphold me according to Your word.
Remove from me the way of falsehood, and graciously grant me Your Torah.
The way of faithfulness I have chosen; Your judgments I have set before me.
I have clung to Your testimonies; Havayah, do not shame me.
The way of Your commandments I shall run, for You have broadened my heart. (End of the passage.)

he: הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃
en: Teach me, Havayah, the way of Your statutes, and I shall keep it to the end.
Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your Torah, and observe it with all my heart.
Guide me in the path of Your commandments, for in it I delight.
Incline my heart to Your testimonies, and not to covetous gain.

he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
en: Turn my eyes from seeing vanity; in Your way revive me.
Establish Your saying to Your servant, which belongs to Your fear.

he: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִֽים׃
en: Remove my reproach, which I fear; for Your judgments are good.
Behold, I have longed for Your precepts; in Your righteousness revive me. (End of the passage.)
And let Your kindness come to me, Havayah — Your salvation, according to Your saying.
And I shall answer my reviler with a word, for I have trusted in Your word.

he: וְֽאַל־תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר־אֱמֶ֣ת עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
en: And do not utterly snatch the word of truth from my mouth, for I have hoped in Your judgment.
And I shall keep Your Torah continually, forever and ever.
And I shall walk in a broad place, for I have sought Your precepts.

he: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
en: And I shall speak of Your testimonies before kings, and not be ashamed.
And I shall delight in Your commandments, which I have loved.

he: וְאֶשָּֽׂא־כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל־מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃ {פ}
en: And I shall lift my hands to Your commandments, which I have loved, and I shall meditate on Your statutes. (End of the passage.)
Remember the word to Your servant, upon which You have made me hope.

he: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעׇנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃
en: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Your saying has revived me.

he: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּ֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
en: The insolent have derided me greatly; from Your Torah I have not turned.
I have remembered Your judgments of old, Havayah, and I have been comforted.
Horror has seized me because of the wicked, who forsake Your Torah.
Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my sojourning.

he: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה וָ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
en: I have remembered Your name in the night, Havayah, and I have kept Your Torah.
This has been mine, because I have kept Your precepts. (End of the passage.)
My portion, Havayah, I have said, is to keep Your words.
I have entreated Your favor with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your saying.
I have reckoned my ways, and turned my feet to Your testimonies.
I hastened and did not delay, to keep Your commandments.

he: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּ֥֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
en: The cords of the wicked have twisted about me; Your Torah I have not forgotten.

he: חֲצֽוֹת־לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
en: At midnight I rise to thank You for Your righteous judgments.

he: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכׇל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
en: I am a companion to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.

he: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃ {פ}
en: Your kindness, Havayah, fills the earth; teach me Your statutes. (End of the passage.)
You have done good with Your servant, Havayah, according to Your word.

he: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃
en: Teach me good taste and knowledge, for I have believed in Your commandments.

he: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃
en: Before I was afflicted, I erred; but now I keep Your saying.
You are good, and do good; teach me Your statutes.

he: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכׇל־לֵ֤ב ׀ אֶצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
en: The insolent have smeared falsehood upon me; I with all my heart shall keep Your precepts.

he: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃
en: Their heart is gross as fat; I delight in Your Torah.
It is good for me that I was afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
The Torah of Your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver. (End of the passage.)

he: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
en: Your hands have made me and established me; give me understanding, and I shall learn Your commandments.

he: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
en: They who fear You shall see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.

he: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הֹוָה כִּי־צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃
en: I know, Havayah, that Your judgments are righteousness, and in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
Let Your kindness be to comfort me, according to Your saying to Your servant.
Let Your mercies come to me, and I shall live, for Your Torah is my delight.

he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
en: Let the insolent be ashamed, for falsely they have subverted me; I shall meditate on Your precepts.
Let them return to me who fear You, and they who know Your testimonies.

he: יְהִי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃ {פ}
en: Let my heart be perfect in Your statutes, that I may not be ashamed. (End of the passage.)
My soul pines for Your salvation; in Your word I hope.

he: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
en: My eyes pine for Your saying, saying: When will You comfort me?

he: כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
en: For I have become as a wineskin in smoke; Your statutes I have not forgotten.

he: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
en: How many are the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment upon my pursuers?

he: כָּרוּ־לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
en: The insolent have dug pits for me, which is not according to Your Torah.
All Your commandments are faithfulness; falsely they pursue me — help me.

he: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּדֶֽיךָ׃
en: They had almost consumed me on earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
According to Your kindness revive me, and I shall keep the testimony of Your mouth. (End of the passage.)
Forever, Havayah, Your word stands firm in the heavens.

he: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּֽ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃
en: From generation to generation is Your faithfulness; You have founded the earth, and it stands.

he: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
en: They stand today according to Your judgments, for all are Your servants.

he: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעׇנְיִֽי׃
en: Were not Your Torah my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.

he: לְ֭עוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃
en: Never shall I forget Your precepts, for with them You have revived me.
I am Yours — save me, for I have sought Your precepts.

he: לִ֤י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְאַבְּדֵ֑נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; I shall understand Your testimonies.

he: לְֽכׇל־תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד׃ {פ}
en: To every limit I have seen an end; Your commandment is exceeding broad. (End of the passage.)
How I love Your Torah; all the day it is my meditation.

he: מֵֽ֭אֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֺתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם הִיא־לִֽי׃
en: Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is ever mine.

he: מִכׇּל־מְלַמְּדַ֥י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽי׃
en: From all my teachers I have gained understanding, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
From the aged I have understanding, for I have kept Your precepts.

he: מִכׇּל־אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃
en: From every evil way I have restrained my feet, that I may keep Your word.
From Your judgments I have not turned, for You have taught me.
How sweet to my palate are Your sayings — more than honey to my mouth.

he: מִפִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי ׀ כׇּל־אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר׃ {פ}
en: From Your precepts I have understanding; therefore I hate every false way. (End of the passage.)
A lamp to my feet is Your word, and a light to my path.
I have sworn, and I shall keep it, to observe Your righteous judgments.
I have been afflicted greatly; Havayah, revive me according to Your word.

he: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭י רְצֵה־נָ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
en: Accept, I pray, Havayah, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, and teach me Your judgments.

he: נַפְשִׁ֣י בְכַפִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
en: My soul is in my hand continually, and Your Torah I have not forgotten.

he: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי׃
en: The wicked have set a snare for me, yet from Your precepts I have not strayed.

he: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָ֑ם כִּֽי־שְׂשׂ֖וֹן לִבִּ֣י הֵֽמָּה׃
en: I have inherited Your testimonies forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

he: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת חֻקֶּ֗יךָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב׃ {פ}
en: I have inclined my heart to do Your statutes forever, to the end. (End of the passage.)
The divided-hearted I hate, and Your Torah I love.
My hiding-place and my shield are You; in Your word I hope.
Depart from me, evildoers, and I shall keep the commandments of my Elokim.
Support me according to Your saying, and I shall live; and do not shame me from my hope.
Sustain me, and I shall be saved, and I shall ever gaze upon Your statutes.
You have trodden down all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceit is falsehood.

he: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כׇל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
en: As dross You have made all the wicked of the earth cease; therefore I love Your testimonies.
My flesh bristles from fear of You, and from Your judgments I am afraid. (End of the passage.)
I have done judgment and righteousness; do not leave me to my oppressors.
Be surety for Your servant for good; let not the insolent oppress me.
My eyes pine for Your salvation, and for the saying of Your righteousness.
Deal with Your servant according to Your kindness, and teach me Your statutes.
I am Your servant — give me understanding, and I shall know Your testimonies.
It is time to act for Havayah: they have broken Your Torah.
Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, and than fine gold.

he: עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ כׇּל־פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כׇּל־אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃ {פ}
en: Therefore I esteem all precepts of all things right; every false way I hate. (End of the passage.)
Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore my soul has kept them.
The opening of Your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
I have opened my mouth and panted, for I have longed for Your commandments.
Turn to me, and be gracious to me, as is the due of those who love Your name.
Establish my steps in Your saying, and let no iniquity have dominion over me.
Redeem me from the oppression of man, and I shall keep Your precepts.
Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.

he: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑י עַ֝֗ל לֹא־שָׁמְר֥וּ תוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
en: Streams of water have flowed from my eyes, because they have not kept Your Torah. (End of the passage.)
Righteous are You, Havayah, and upright are Your judgments.
You have commanded the righteousness of Your testimonies, and exceeding faithfulness.
My zeal has consumed me, for my adversaries have forgotten Your words.
Your saying is exceedingly refined, and Your servant loves it.

he: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְנִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
en: I am young and despised; Your precepts I have not forgotten.
Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and Your Torah is truth.
Distress and anguish have found me; Your commandments are my delights.
The righteousness of Your testimonies is forever; give me understanding, and I shall live. (End of the passage.)

he: קָרָ֣אתִי בְכׇל־לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה׃
en: I have called with all my heart — answer me, Havayah; Your statutes I shall keep.
I have called You — save me, and I shall keep Your testimonies.
I have come before the twilight and cried out; in Your word I have hoped.
My eyes have come before the watches, to meditate on Your saying.

he: ק֭וֹלִי שִׁמְעָ֣ה כְחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
en: Hear my voice according to Your kindness; Havayah, revive me according to Your judgment.
The pursuers of lewdness draw near; from Your Torah they are far.
You are near, Havayah, and all Your commandments are truth.

he: קֶ֣דֶם יָ֭דַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְסַדְתָּֽם׃ {פ}
en: Long ago I knew from Your testimonies, that You have founded them forever. (End of the passage.)
See my affliction, and deliver me, for Your Torah I have not forgotten.
Plead my cause, and redeem me; revive me according to Your saying.

he: רָח֣וֹק מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים יְשׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃
en: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they have not sought Your statutes.
Your mercies are many, Havayah; revive me according to Your judgments.

he: רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣י וְצָרָ֑י מֵ֝עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
en: Many are my pursuers and my adversaries; from Your testimonies I have not turned.

he: רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָ֑טָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
en: I have seen traitors and contended with them, who have not kept Your saying.

he: רְ֭אֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
en: See that I have loved Your precepts; Havayah, revive me according to Your kindness.
The beginning of Your word is truth, and forever is every judgment of Your righteousness. (End of the passage.)
Princes have pursued me without cause, and of Your word my heart is afraid.

he: שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כְּ֝מוֹצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב׃
en: I rejoice over Your saying, as one who finds great spoil.
Falsehood I hate and abhor; Your Torah I love.

he: שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭יּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּ֑יךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
en: Seven times a day I have praised You for Your righteous judgments.

he: שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין־לָ֥מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל׃
en: Great peace have they who love Your Torah, and there is no stumbling for them.
I have hoped for Your salvation, Havayah, and Your commandments I have done.
My soul has kept Your testimonies, and I love them greatly.

he: שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י כׇל־דְּרָכַ֣י נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃ {פ}
en: I have kept Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You. (End of the passage.)

he: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃
en: Let my song come near before You, Havayah; make me understand according to Your word.
Let my supplication come before You; deliver me according to Your saying.

he: תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
en: My lips shall utter praise, for You shall teach me Your statutes.

he: תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י כׇל־מִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ צֶּֽדֶק׃
en: My tongue shall answer Your saying, for all Your commandments are righteousness.
Let Your hand be to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
I have longed for Your salvation, Havayah, and Your Torah is my delight.
Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; and let Your judgments help me.

he: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃ {פ}
en: I have strayed as a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments. (End of the passage.)
